# META — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (Apr 29 AH) remain the controlling catalyst on Day 7 of the post-print re-rating window. Capex guidance of **$125–145B** (raised again from $115–135B) continues to drive institutional multiple compression. **Key macro shift (May 6):** US-Iran ceasefire MOU reportedly 48 hours away — S&P 500 and Nasdaq at ATH, oil at ~$110/bbl (above prior estimates; ceasefire could sharply reduce energy prices if signed). New Mexico $3.7B youth-harm trial ongoing; Reuters Pulitzer reporting on harmful AI chatbots and fraudulent ads adds fresh reputational pressure. No new binary catalyst until Q2 2026 earnings (~July 29). (source: web_research/META.json, run 20260506_140335)

## Live catalysts

| Event | Date | Significance |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2026 post-earnings re-rating window | Apr 29 – ~May 9 | HIGH — capex shock still being absorbed; multiple compression ongoing |
| New Mexico $3.7B youth-harm trial | Started May 2026 | HIGH NEGATIVE — seeks platform overhaul + $3.7B; combined CA 70% verdict + $375M prior award = compounding litigation exposure |
| US-Iran ceasefire MOU | ~48 hours (May 6) | MACRO SWING — ceasefire would cut oil, boost broad risk appetite; partial offset to short thesis |
| Fed Chair transition (Powell → Warsh) | May 15 | MEDIUM NEGATIVE — hawkish succession; rate-tightening tail risk elevated for high-multiple tech |
| Layoff restructuring (~8,000 employees / 10% workforce) | Ongoing (Apr–May 2026) | MEDIUM — cost discipline signal partially offsets capex alarm; 6,000 open roles frozen |
| Social media addiction litigation | Ongoing | HIGH NEGATIVE — CA 70% liability verdict, 10,000+ suits, NM $375M award + new $3.7B trial |
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 29, 2026 | MEDIUM — no widely-reported estimate yet; consensus ~$59.48B revenue expected |

## Recent news (as of May 6, 2026)

**Snap Q1 2026 profit (POSITIVE READ-THROUGH):** Snap swung to a $45M Q1 profit, a positive signal for the digital advertising market. Partial offset to META bearish thesis — ad business structural demand intact. (source: signals_combined.json swing_head_trader, run 20260506_140335)

**US-Iran ceasefire talks advancing (MACRO SHIFT):** Reports indicate a US-Iran memorandum of understanding is ~48 hours away as of May 6. Equities responded positively (S&P +0.72%, Nasdaq +0.73%). If deal solidifies, oil drops sharply, removing an energy-inflation headwind. Note: oil currently ~$110/bbl — higher than prior $102 estimates; ceasefire impact would be meaningful. Macro is net cautiously bullish. (source: web_research/META.json macro_context, run 20260506_140335)

**Reuters Pulitzer Prize (HIGH NEGATIVE, unchanged):** Reuters won a Pulitzer for beat reporting on Meta — harmful AI chatbots exposed to children and billions made from fraudulent ads. Reputational and regulatory risk elevated. (source: web_research/META.json ticker_news, run 20260506_140335)

**Meta El Paso AI data centre (MINOR POSITIVE):** Secured ~$13B financing from Morgan Stanley/JPMorgan for a 1-gigawatt data centre (target opening 2028). Confirms capital access but also confirms the scale of the capex commitment. (source: web_research/META.json ticker_news, run 20260506_140335)

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
2026-05-06 | GOOG | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$6.50 | Mean-reversion short (RSI-7 90.69, Z-score 2.56) stopped at $389.50 as ADX 74.23 extreme trend absorbed the fade; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime repeated the NVDA/AMZN pattern — ADX 60+ environments make fading overbought conditions highly unreliable; strongly risk-on macro (S&P ATH, US-Iran MOU) added upside momentum.
2026-05-06 | AMD | statistical exhaustion short | OUTCOME: -$17.82 | Mean-reversion short (Z-score 2.6, RSI 83, +74% 21d surge) gap-stopped at $372.31 when Q1 2026 earnings blowout (+38% YoY, EPS +43%) gapped AMD +15% overnight; swing_mean_reversion and swing_catalyst_news recommended the fade but earnings binary created a non-linear gap-through-stop outcome; half-sizing to 1 share limited damage to -$17.82 vs -$35.64.
